metric_derivation: advance_pt = (Widths[code-FirstChar]/1000 * font_size + Tc + (Tw if code==32)) * Tz/100 = (600/1000*10 + 0 + 0) * 1 = 6.0; expected x = block origin x + 6.0 * index_in_block; expected y = block baseline y
